body.subject: Narrowed: mcp-platform seam ALREADY exists; single blocker is api document_connector_accounts uniqueness + provider enum
body.text:
Refining my previous ping with code-verified findings so you have a one-decision unblock.

MCP SIDE IS ALREADY SUFFICIENT (verified in packages/mcp-platform/src/runtime.ts):
- ConnectorEnrollment already carries id(connectorInstanceId), connectorId, principalSub, tenantRef, optional workspaceRef, state, secretRefs. That is exactly multi-account + workspace segmentation.
- StpConnectorContext already exposes tenantRef, workspaceRef, connectorInstanceId and getSecret(name) by REFERENCE, so tokens never enter mcp-platform.
- AppConnectorProviderAdapter already defines listCapabilities/invokeTool/readResource, so wrapping GDrive/Gmail is a normal adapter, not new platform surface.
- ARCH-11 async TenantResolver (PR #439) gives per-invocation fail-closed tenant authorization.

SO THE ONLY REAL BLOCKER IS API-SIDE, YOUR PLANE:
api/drizzle/0026_google_drive_connector_accounts.sql defines document_connector_accounts with UNIQUE(workspace_id,user_id,provider) and CHECK(provider IN ('google_drive')). Consequences: exactly ONE Google account per user per workspace, and Gmail cannot be stored at all. No MCP-side change can lift that.

MINIMAL DECISION REQUESTED (single answer):
1) Do you take a migration that (a) replaces the unique index with one allowing N accounts per (workspace,user,provider) keyed by the existing id, and (b) extends the provider CHECK to include gmail? YES/NO.
2) Confirm mcp-platform receives ONLY the opaque connector account id as connectorInstanceId, with secrets resolved api-side through secretRefs/getSecret. YES/NO.

If both YES, my MCP work is: GDrive and Gmail adapters implementing AppConnectorProviderAdapter against the existing api services, capability manifest with allowlist, workspace/tenant fail-closed authorization, zero token handling. I can start that adapter work immediately on a dedicated MCP branch and it will be ready when your migration lands.

If you prefer a different account-identity shape, say it now and I align. I am not touching api, migrations, connectors, gateway or mesh.
